question: Which of the following is a greenish yellow gas with a characteristic smell at room temperature?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chlorine**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Chlorine is a **greenish-yellow gas at room temperature and atmospheric pressure while gases like hydrogen, nitrogen, and oxygen are colourless.**
 
• Chlorine is a** chemical element with symbol Cl **and atomic number 17.
 
• The **second-lightest of the halogens**, it appears between fluorine and bromine in the periodic table and its properties are mostly intermediate between them
 
• **Usage** 
 
 
• Sodium and chlorine react with each other in order to create a product that is common to almost all in the world: sodium chloride(table salt): 
 
• 2Na(s) + Cl2(g) ——> 2NaCl(s)
 
 
 
• It is easy to see why this reaction happens so rapidly when we look at it at the atomic level: sodium has one electron in its outermost (valence) shell, while chlorine has seven electrons in its valence shell.
 
• When a sodium atom passes an electron to a chlorine atom, which forms a sodium cation (Na+) and a chloride anion (Cl-), all ions have full valence shells and are energetically more stable.
 
• The reaction is highly exothermic, creating a bright yellow light and a lot of heat energy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Iodine**:

 
 
• Iodine typically appears as a solid (grayish or purplish-black) at room temperature but sublimates into a violet gas when heated.
 
• It does not have the characteristic greenish-yellow color of chlorine.
 
 
 
• **Hydrogen Sulphide**:
 
 
• Hydrogen sulfide (H₂S) is a colorless gas known for its strong odor of rotten eggs. 
 
 
 
• **Carbon Monoxide**:
 
 
• Carbon monoxide (CO) is a colorless, odorless gas that is produced from incomplete combustion of carbon-containing fuels.
 
• It does not have a characteristic smell and is very dangerous when inhaled due to its ability to prevent oxygen transport in the bloodstream.
